headline: NXP co-op listing assigns AMS and digital integration, wreal views, simulation and silicon bring-up
fact: A Discover Technata recruiting listing dated February 7 advertised an NXP Analog Mixed-Signal Design Co-Op for early-career engineers. The role supports analog/digital integration, schematic and netlist views, connectivity checks, Verilog-AMS and wreal view generation, simple RTL wrappers and digital-on-top build checks. It also assigns block- and top-level Spectre/Xcelium/AMS Designer simulations, testbench and model packaging work, and automated lab measurements including power-up sequences. The listing is no longer accepting applications; its date is the recruiting board's posting date.
